items.Sentence: The secondary treatment process at the Facility consists of a 300,000-gallon capacity oxidation ditch...
The secondary treatment process ... secondary clarifier ... A small portion of solids may be returned from the clarifier to the inlet structure prior to the oxidation ditch.
The secondary treatment process ... chlorine disinfection and dechlorination facilities.
Solids are removed from the secondary clarifier and pumped to a sludge thickener ... Supernatant from the thickener is also returned to the inlet structure prior to the oxidation ditch.
Solids are removed from the secondary clarifier and pumped to a sludge thickener, sludge drying beds.
From May 15 through September 30, treated wastewater is discharged ... to percolation ponds located in an upland area away from the river channel and floodplain.
